book.title: 使至塞上
book.subtitle: 一轮落日照着大漠长河

poem.author: 王维
englishLines: A lone carriage travels to the frontier,
Passing beyond Juyan on a mission.
Like drifting tumbleweed, I leave the Han border,
While returning geese fly into the northern sky.
Across the vast desert, one column of smoke rises straight,
Beside the long river, the setting sun is round.
At Xiao Pass, I meet a mounted scout,
Who says the commander is far away at Yanran.

appreciation.zh: 诗人乘车穿过辽阔边塞，飞蓬和归雁陪他远行。天地越走越开阔，最后只剩直直的孤烟、长长的河流和圆圆的落日。
appreciation.en: The poet crosses the broad frontier with tumbleweed and returning geese. The world opens wider until a straight thread of smoke, a long river, and a round sunset fill the view.

pages.zhText:
单车欲问边，
属国过居延。
征蓬出汉塞，
归雁入胡天。
大漠孤烟直，
长河落日圆。
萧关逢候骑，
都护在燕然。
pages.enText:
A lone carriage travels to the frontier,
Passing beyond Juyan on a mission.
Like drifting tumbleweed, I leave the Han border,
While returning geese fly into the northern sky.
Across the vast desert, one column of smoke rises straight,
Beside the long river, the setting sun is round.
At Xiao Pass, I meet a mounted scout,
Who says the commander is far away at Yanran.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Immense peaceful Tang frontier at golden hour, a tiny covered travel carriage and gentle poet on a safe sandy road, long blue-green river curving through ochre desert, one thin straight smoke column far away and a perfectly round setting sun, no battle, no text.

pages.zhText:
单车欲问边，
属国过居延。
诗人乘着一辆轻车，沿着长路去往遥远的边地。
pages.enText:
A lone carriage travels to the frontier,
Passing beyond Juyan on a mission.
The poet follows a long road toward the distant frontier.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide morning view of the same modest Tang travel carriage moving alone along a pale desert road, same teal-robed poet seated safely, distant low watch post and open sky, peaceful official journey, no weapons or text.

pages.zhText:
征蓬出汉塞，
归雁入胡天。
滚动的飞蓬越过关塞，成行的大雁也飞向北方。
pages.enText:
Like drifting tumbleweed, I leave the Han border,
While returning geese fly into the northern sky.
Tumbleweed rolls past the pass as geese travel north.
pages.illustrationPrompt: The same carriage passing a simple earthen Tang frontier gate, one round tumbleweed drifting across the road and a clear V of wild geese flying north, strong wind shown gently in robe and grasses, no battle or text.

pages.zhText:
大漠孤烟直，
长河落日圆。
沙漠一望无边，一缕烟直直升起，圆圆的夕阳贴近长河。
pages.enText:
Across the vast desert, one column of smoke rises straight,
Beside the long river, the setting sun is round.
The desert stretches wide beneath one straight smoke trail and a round sun.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Iconic panoramic desert-river sunset, enormous negative space, one very thin vertical smoke column from a distant peaceful cooking fire, long river reflecting a large round orange sun, same poet and carriage tiny in foreground, no flames, war or text.

pages.zhText:
萧关逢候骑，
都护在燕然。
到了萧关，诗人遇见传递消息的骑手，知道前方的人还在更远处。
pages.enText:
At Xiao Pass, I meet a mounted scout,
Who says the commander is far away at Yanran.
At the pass, a messenger brings news from farther ahead.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Friendly meeting at a quiet earthen pass near dusk, same poet beside his carriage greeting one mounted Tang messenger with open hand, horse calm and lightly equipped, no combat gear, distant road continues toward mountains, no text.

pages.zhText: 轻车走过关塞，飞蓬滚过沙地，归雁掠过天空。长河一直陪着落日伸向远方。
pages.enText: The carriage crosses the pass, tumbleweed rolls, and geese sweep overhead. The long river follows the sunset into the distance.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Continuous visual journey across the same broad frontier: carriage trail, rolling tumbleweed, geese, river and sunset align toward the horizon, tranquil scale and spacious rice-paper sky, no battle or text.

pages.zhText: 人在这样的天地里显得很小，心却会被辽阔慢慢打开。你会先看见直直的烟，还是圆圆的太阳？
pages.enText: A traveler looks tiny in such a world, yet the open land makes the heart feel wide. Would you notice the straight smoke or the round sun first?
pages.illustrationPrompt: Contemplative rear view of same poet standing safely beside carriage above the river, tiny figure facing immense desert, thin smoke and round sunset balanced in calm composition, wonder rather than loneliness, no text.

pages.zhText:
单车欲问边，
属国过居延。
征蓬出汉塞，
归雁入胡天。
大漠孤烟直，
长河落日圆。
萧关逢候骑，
都护在燕然。
再轻轻读一遍吧。
pages.enText:
A lone carriage travels to the frontier,
Passing beyond Juyan on a mission.
Like drifting tumbleweed, I leave the Han border,
While returning geese fly into the northern sky.
Across the vast desert, one column of smoke rises straight,
Beside the long river, the setting sun is round.
At Xiao Pass, I meet a mounted scout,
Who says the commander is far away at Yanran.
Now read it softly once more.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing blue-hour panorama, same carriage follows the river road away, last round sun touches horizon, straight smoke remains delicate and far, first evening star in vast sky, peaceful frontier, no text.
